why: Test already-qualified native/tokenless CVH01 earned-return memory against authentic source-observed FKP26 public causal MDP transitions instead of further fabricated worlds. Reuse CVH01, CVH02, CVH03 and independent strong conventional batch; no new learner, hardware, original first use or protected source.
known_preprereg_disclosure: An earlier source admission already reported per-seed reward totals 16/15/18/17 and first 2 transition rows of each seed were viewed while verifying the original artifact. Thus held outcomes are NOT fresh blind and scores may not be labeled independent science.

frozen_split.mechanics: Original 31-step episodes; strict within-episode ordering, before/after continuity, no cross-episode prefix leakage.

source_data_encoding.public_rows: 6 binary fields in order before, action, reward, after, terminated, truncated; one 6-bit unsigned byte per row rendered 2 hex digits, 31 rows per seed
source_data_encoding.verify: Decode all four source episode rows; recompute FKP24 canonical JSON list SHA256 and verify 4 original pinned transition hashes + counts + terminal flags; source fixture is non-private and already consumed.
source_data_encoding.provenance: Preserve original archive digest and source PR/run IDs; NEVER claim fixtures are newly independent

candidate.model: EXACT qualified CVH-01 EarnedReturnMemory, unchanged source
candidate.input: Only six public prior observed fields, no source-private state, action from recorded fixed policy
candidate.train: Observe exactly 62 TRAIN rows in chronological episodes; no held model update before frozen held predictions; snapshot cold restore then score
candidate.prediction: four-step discounted genuine reward units: current reward + 0.5 next + 0.25 next2 + 0.125 next3, truncating after episode end
candidate.unsupported: ABSTAIN, never impute source facts; separately calculate frozen TRAIN global fallback only for all-row utility metric
candidate.capacity: 36 count/weighted return slots, no parameter growth

controls.strong_exact: CVH-01/strong_conventional.batch_public_returns() independently fitted on same 62 TRAIN source events, exact context and return horizon; no CVH01 estimator imports, source-oracle access or held labels. This predicts identically if native is correct and is the strongest information-equivalent exact symbolic comparator.
controls.train_prior: mean four-step actual TRAIN return on 62 rows, predicts all 62 held rows
controls.hierarchical_bayes: one-slot fully fitted conditional posterior mean with a frozen 2.0 pseudo-count toward TRAIN global return; action-context support may be 0; full coverage
controls.immediate_ablation: CVH-01 independent immediate_only_public_returns fitted same TRAIN public events, compare only native-supported held rows
controls.negative_permutation: train-only rotate each episode public reward bits forward by 7 positions; preserve state/action/next-state/terminal; train CVH01 after rewrite on observed-only source; evaluate exact same held rows on overlap support; not a legal causal replay or strong control

outcome.primary: All 62 retrospective held action prefixes scored without accessing held future rewards until candidate/controls frozen for that row; evaluator computes exact 4-step public return offline from already-consumed tape.
outcome.honest_limits: Recorded fixed untrained policy confounds action choices, so off-policy causal value and counterfactual outcomes are unidentifiable; this measures prediction of observed policy returns, not policy gains.

preregistered_decision.development_source_learning_signal: Both held seeds jointly have >=16/62 supported contexts AND candidate 4-step return MSE on the same supported rows beats TRAIN global prior by >=0.01, AND original source hash, byte-stable cold restore, independent exact conventional parity and negative boundaries pass. This is a retrospective predictive-memory signal ONLY, not scientific superiority.
preregistered_decision.development_no_go: Any threshold failure, exact strong-control tie (expected), inability to read authentic public source or overly small coverage must be preserved without changing split or support threshold.
preregistered_decision.full_qualification: Full inherited repository regression and inherited CVH01/02/03 plus CVH04 focused+negative tests Ubuntu and Windows, derived atlas update only, exact final candidate SHA/tree, scored same inputs with exact hashes, no new original scientific first use.
